commitResults.messageTitle: Rename chatbot and add initial code
feat: support typed todo deadline and event tasks
commitResults.messageBody: Add typed task models and parse todo, deadline, and event commands while preserving task completion and listing behavior.
Keep AGENTS.md focused on agent guidance and move commands, formats, and important file details into project documentation.

commitResults.messageTitle: chore: ignore local agents and add UI test plan
commitResults.messageBody: Keep environment-specific agent configuration out of version control and include the project UI test plan.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor command handling & add exception handling
Extract Ui class for command-line interaction
commitResults.messageBody: Move Miku's console encoding setup and all user-facing banners, confirmations, errors, separators, and task-list rendering into Ui. This gives the application entry point a single interaction collaborator while preserving existing command behaviour and exact UI output. Document the new responsibility in PROJECT_BEHAVIOR.

Move ownership of Miku's mutable task collection into TaskList, including task addition, lookup, removal, counting, and immutable snapshots for persistence. This narrows Miku to command coordination and protects the collection from accidental external mutation. Update behavior documentation with the new class responsibility.

Move raw-command recognition, task-command field validation, date parsing, and task construction from Miku into Parser. Miku now dispatches typed parsed commands while retaining task mutations and persistence, preserving current interaction behaviour. Document Parser's responsibility.

commitResults.messageTitle: Load saved tasks through Storage at startup
commitResults.messageBody: Add JSON deserialization to Storage so todos, deadlines, events, completion state, and date-time display flags are restored when Miku starts. Fall back to an empty list with a friendly UI message for unavailable or invalid save data. Isolate UI tests in temporary working directories and add a save-file fixture case to verify restoration.

commitResults.messageTitle: Execute parsed commands through Command subclasses
commitResults.messageBody: Replace Parser's tagged parsed-command record and Miku's command switch with executable Command subclasses for adding, listing, marking, unmarking, deleting, and exiting. Share task-number lookup and persistence behavior where appropriate, leaving Miku to coordinate parse, execution, and exit state. Preserve command output and document the command hierarchy.

commitResults.messageTitle: Organize Java sources into responsibility packages
commitResults.messageBody: Move Miku sources from the flat default package into miku, miku.command, miku.parser, miku.storage, miku.task, and miku.ui. Update imports, test launching, and documentation for the packaged miku.Miku entry point. Add the repository rule that future Java files must follow this structure, and expose Task read accessors needed across the storage boundary.

commitResults.messageTitle: Move command reading into Ui run loop
commitResults.messageBody: Turn Miku into an instance-based coordinator with a run method, and move standard-input reading into Ui through an EOF-safe Optional API. Centralize post-command separator output in Miku's finally block while preserving existing successful and error response formatting. Document the run-loop responsibility.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add DateTimeParser JUnit coverage for supported formats
Document high-value JUnit coverage maintenance target
Standards: Enforce SE-EDU Java and Git rules
commitResults.messageBody:
The project has no shared, tracked standard for Java style or commit
messages. This makes future changes depend on individual agent defaults.

Add project-specific SE-EDU Java and Git skills, and require them from
both agent instruction files. Update existing Java code and its parser
tests to use predicate boolean names, consistent imports, and compliant
line wrapping while preserving persisted JSON keys.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add find command for task descriptions
commitResults.messageBody:
Task descriptions currently cannot be searched, which makes locating
related work cumbersome in longer lists. Add a read-only find command
with case-insensitive matching, Miku-style output, and focused unit and
black-box coverage so users can locate matching tasks reliably.
Align switch-expression indentation with the project's four-space style.

Enforce the SE-EDU intermediate Java coding standard for main and test sources.

Document the commands and exception mechanisms so contributors can run the
checks consistently.

Miku currently starts as a terminal application, which cannot host the
JavaFX interface required for Level 10.

Add the tutorial's cross-platform JavaFX dependencies and launch Miku
through a dedicated non-JavaFX entry point so Gradle can open an
initial JavaFX window reliably.

The JavaFX launcher currently shows only a greeting label and cannot
represent a Miku conversation.

Add the tutorial's scrollable chat layout, message control, and empty
avatar resource directory so later stages can connect real commands
without requiring image files to exist yet.

commitResults.messageTitle: GUI: Connect chat input to Miku
commitResults.messageBody:
Commands currently write directly to terminal output, preventing the chat
controls from displaying Miku's real task responses.

Return formatted command responses through Miku, wire Send and Enter to
that API, and retain persistence while adding coverage for the new
GUI-facing behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: GUI: Move chat layout to FXML
commitResults.messageBody:
The working chat layout is still constructed entirely in Java, making
visual changes harder to inspect and maintain.

Move the main view and reusable dialog markup into FXML, keeping small
controllers for interaction and preserving the same GUI behavior.

The FXML chat view lacks the responsive constraints and visual identity
covered by the final JavaFX tutorial stage, while project guidance still
describes a retired terminal UI.

Anchor the chat controls, add Miku-themed CSS, document GUI launch and
avatar setup, and remove the obsolete console UI harness. Also allow
custom storage files without a parent directory.

Miku's configured avatar paths use PNG filenames, but the supplied
avatars are JPEG files.

Load the JPG resource names and update the user-facing setup guidance
so the optional images appear without renaming user-provided assets.
